name: Proton Pack
description: A small unlicensed nuclear accelerator — the Ghostbusters' basic weapon. Attack setting lowers a ghost's Ectopresence by 1 per hit; Containment forms a beam-cage (needs two 'Busters and Ectopresence 0) to steer a ghost over a trap. Scorches walls and upholstery. NEVER cross the beams.

name: Ghost Trap
description: A small box that stores and transports one subdued ghost. A foot-pedal on twelve feet of tubing opens the lid; it channels the target in, then closes. Store captured ghosts in the franchise's Protection Grid.

name: PKE Meter
description: A psychokinetic energy meter. When a ghost is near, the arms rise and the lights flash — the closer and more powerful the presence, the higher they go.

name: Ecto-Visors
description: Spook-finder glasses that let a Ghostbuster see in the dark. They also eliminate all peripheral vision and look dumb on elevators.

name: ECTO-1
description: The Ectomobile — seats three in luxury or six in desperation, with cargo room for a full line of paranormal gear. Flashing lights, roof gimcracks, and about as inconspicuous as a moose hiding in your refrigerator.

name: Alpine Gear
description: Pitons, hammers, rope, clamps and cute lederhosen — lets you roll 3 extra dice using Muscles or Climb to scale a skyscraster, elevator shaft or the Matterhorn.

name: Aura Video-Analyzer
description: A helmet-cam that reads a subject's emotional state (lying, in love, in pain) and their essence (hero, movie star, wild beast). If a subject is possessed, it shows the outline of the entity inside.

name: Bullhorn
description: For making yourself heard over the hubbub of a cocktail party — or for telling a ghost to surrender before you move in.

name: Geiger Counter
description: For radioactive ghosts, radioactive monsters, or malfunctioning unlicensed nuclear accelerators. The louder the crackle, the stronger the radiation — if it gets too loud, leave before your hair and teeth fall out.

name: Infrared Camera
description: Takes pictures of ghosts in the dark, even when they're normally invisible. Remote-operate it (difficulty 10) or rig a trip-beam (difficulty 5).

name: Parachute
description: Always works — unless you roll a Ghost and the Ghostmaster feels really mean.

name: Protection Grid
description: A large, immobile grid at the franchise that safely stores an enormous number of ghosts. After many adventures it can fill up and threaten to collapse — build a second one if you get worried.

name: Scuba Gear
description: A one-tank wetsuit good for about 30 minutes underwater — for haunted sewers, sea-monster stories and similar aquatic situations. Roll Muscles or Swim to do more than paddle.

name: Secret Tomes of Occult Lore
description: Tobin's Spirit Guide, Spates Catalogue of Nameless Horrors, the Ghostbuster's Handbook and their ilk. Look up a ghost's nature, weaknesses and history — or stumble into an adventure via something you read.

name: Video Camcorder
description: Record a ghost's attack firsthand (some ghosts don't register on video, so pick the right kind) — or shoot ads for local TV.

name: Walkie-Talkies
description: A necessity when the group splits up. Range of a few hundred yards; pick up static and trucker chatter, and may fail near powerful psychokinetic forces.

name: Brass Knuckles
description: Add 1 die to your Muscles or Brawl attack.

name: Blackjack
description: Add 1 die to your attack.

name: Switchblade
description: Add 2 dice to your attack.

name: Bullwhip
description: Add 2 dice to your attack.

name: Frying Pan
description: Add 2 dice to your attack. Also good for eggs.

name: Club
description: Add 3 dice to your attack.

name: Chair
description: Add 3 dice to your attack.

name: Sword
description: Add 3 dice to your attack.

name: Battle Axe
description: Add 4 dice to your attack.

name: Chain Saw
description: Add 4 dice to your attack.

name: Power Drill
description: Add 4 dice to your attack.

name: Pistol
description: Point-blank (≤10 ft) difficulty 5, normal 10, long (50 ft+) 20. Knives and pistols don't work on ghosts — use a proton pack.

name: Rifle
description: Point-blank difficulty 5, normal 10, long distance (500 ft+) 20. Useless against spooks.

name: Shotgun
description: Loud and messy; point-blank 5, normal 10. Won't bust a ghost.
